meta.title: Our Data Promise — Everstead
meta.description: Your data belongs to you. Export everything anytime, 90-day wind-down commitment, and we will never sell your data. Everstead's full data promise.
meta.ogDescription: Your data belongs to you. Export everything anytime, 90-day wind-down commitment, and we will never sell your data.

hero.title: Your data belongs to you. Always.
hero.subtitle: Everstead is built to last. But we believe you should never feel locked in.

promises.title: Export everything, anytime
promises.body: You can download a complete copy of your entire Everstead plan at any time — accounts, documents, instructions, wishes, and more — in standard readable formats. No hoops, no waiting.

promises.title: 90 days notice if anything changes
promises.body: If Everstead ever ceases trading, we commit to giving every user a minimum of 90 days notice, continued free access to export their data, and clear guidance on what to do next. Your plan will never disappear without warning.

promises.title: We will never sell your data
promises.body: Everstead does not sell, share, or monetise your personal data. Ever. We make money from subscriptions — not from you. Full details are in our Privacy Policy.

commitment.title: Our commitment in full
commitment.intro: Everstead Digital Ltd is registered in England and Wales (Company No. 17166825). We take our responsibility to our users seriously.
items: You can export your complete data at any time from your dashboard settings.
If Everstead ceases trading for any reason, we will give all users a minimum of 90 days written notice before any data is deleted.
During any wind-down period, data export will remain free and unrestricted for all users regardless of subscription status.
We will never sell your personal data to third parties.
You have the right to request deletion of your data at any time by contacting hello@everstead.care.

contact.prefix: If you have any questions about your data or this commitment, please contact us at
contact.suffix: We will respond within 2 business days.
